From: rick.dietz@enron.com
To: drew.fossum@enron.com, britt.davis@enron.com, phil.lowry@enron.com
Date: 2001-08-01
Subject: ONEOK Payment

As we discussed, a wire was sent to ONEOK this afternoon as awarded by the arbitration panel.  The wire, in the amount of $1,143,231.01, was calculated as shown below.

	$1,192,857.73		Amount due ONEOK per the arbitration panel
	     (49,626.72)		Less interest due NNG ($56,097.69 less $6,470.97;
				$196.09 interest per day times 33 days = $6,470.97; 					33 days calculated from arbitration order date 6/27/01 - 8/1/01)
	____________
	$1,143,231.01		Net Amount due ONEOK and wired on 8/1/01
	===========

If you have any questions, please give me a call at (713) 853-5691.

Rick
